name: Footer
summary: The foot of every page of a site: where else to go, the small print and who runs it. Quiet, on the sunken surface, the full width of the window with the page margin inside. Not for an app's status bar or a form's actions (use a Toolbar or the form's own buttons), or for a page's last section (use Section).
a11y: A `footer` placed outside `main` and `article`, so it is the page's contentinfo landmark. Each group of links is a labelled navigation with a real list, so its links are counted; section headings keep the page's outline.

props.name: sections
props.description: Where else to go, in titled sections side by side; they wrap to fewer columns as the room narrows.

props.name: sectionsLabel
props.description: Names the sections' navigation, e.g. "More from Atlas".

props.name: links
props.description: The small-print links in one wrapping row: privacy, cookies, accessibility, contact.

props.name: linksLabel
props.description: Names the small-print navigation. Defaults to "Support links".

props.name: identity
props.description: One line about who runs the site or what it is, e.g. "Atlas is made by the Northwind design team."

props.name: legal
props.description: The legal line: copyright or licence, e.g. "© 2026 Northwind. Text under CC BY 4.0."

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The sections' heading level, from the page's outline. Defaults to 2.

props.name: arrangement
props.description: How the parts are arranged (IP33): `columns` (default: sections side by side, then the small print), `line` (the small print on one wrapping line: links, identity and legal side by side, for a small site) or `identity` (the identity, such as a logo and a line, in its own column beside the sections, then the small print; it stacks above them in a narrow footer).

props.name: external
props.description: Goes to another site: Link's external icon and its spoken twin.

props.name: heading
props.description: What the links have in common, e.g. "Services" or "About us".
